title: Personal LLM Experiments Mini Tracker
summary: Quick personal tracker for small LLM serving experiments: config, cost estimates, quick evals and notes. Use as scratchpad for runs before formalizing into the champ/runner spreadsheet.
content:
Purpose:
- Keep a compact list of quick A/B runs, cost/back-of-envelope, and immediate takeaways. Helps decide which runs to promote to the shared benchmark spreadsheet.

Layout: single page mini-sheet with rows for each run + a notes section. Not intended as canonical records, just a personal scratchpad.

Experiment table (columns: id | date | model | prompt | temp | quant | batch | seq_len | metric | est_cost | notes)

1 | 2025-11-05 | llama2-13b-q4 | summarization-short | 0.2 | q4_0 | 8 | 512 | rougeL=0.37 | $0.028/run | prefix cache helps, try reduced kv cache
2 | 2025-11-12 | phi-70b | summarization-short | 0.1 | fp16 | 1 | 512 | rougeL=0.41 | $0.85/run | much better quality, latency high; try batching
3 | 2026-01-08 | openllama-3b-quant | classification | 0.0 | q4_1 | 32 | 128 | acc=0.88 | $0.003/run | runs cheap; check confusion on rare classes
4 | 2026-01-20 | redwood-vicuna-7b | multi-turn | 0.7 | fp16 | 4 | 1024 | ppl proxy=12.4 | $0.09/run | degenerate outputs with temp>0.6, add top-p clamp
5 | 2026-02-14 | mix-and-match-ensemble | rerank | 0.0 | n/a | 1 | 256 | MRR=0.72 | $0.12/run | ensemble of 3 small models; notable latency cost

Quick notes:
- Est cost: ballpark assumes hosted inference per-token pricing + small overhead for KV cache misses. Recompute when moving to Dedicated.
- Quant labels: q4_0 (aggressive q4), q4_1 (balanced), fp16 (baseline float16).
- Metric column is the quick metric I ran locally (not full eval). Use as signal only.

Immediate action items (personal):
- [ ] Re-run phi-70b with dynamic batching=8 and verify p99 latency (target < 600ms) -- due 2026-02-28
- [ ] Add a focused prompt set (20 couplets) for edge-case summarization behaviors
- [ ] Convert the best phi-70b runs into the shared benchmarks sheet (link to add)

Scratch ideas / questions:
- Can we apply prefix-only KV caching for summarization to reduce tokens sent? Test with run #1.
- Consider trying 4-bit GPTQ for phi-70b to reduce cost; check MMLU-like regressions.
- Is top-p clamping at 0.95 + temp 0.5 better than temp 0.7 for multi-turn coherence?

Quick references:
- personal run dir: /home/sofia/runs/mini-experiments/ (local notes)
- related GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/pull/342
- jira: JIRA-ML-1287 (phi-70b latency investigation)

Last short log (2026-02-21):
- Re-ran openllama-3b-quant with batch=64, observed acc drop to 0.85 (likely dataset shuffle). Will re-check seed and data split.

Notes to self:
- When promoting runs, include: full config file (yaml), seed, exact tokenizer commit, and raw eval script.
- Keep this sheet light: if it grows beyond ~20 rows, create a proper bench spreadsheet in shared_drives/product/hosted-api/benchmarks.
file_notes: Personal mini-sheet; mostly informal. Will be used to assemble formal benchmark entries when promising runs identified.
